primaryText.facts: INAH identifies the large superposed construction/earth-covered pyramid and connected exposed ceremonial courts to south and west. Historical overall base about450m per side; it takes advantage of a natural elevation. Modern church at summit is separately identified.

Municipal description reports roughly400mplus base and66m nominal pyramid height, with multiple overlapping construction stages. Dimensions are descriptive historical totals, not a current surveyed bare-mound surface.

imageryUse: Only exact published AltevirVechia2004PD terrace/altar images; no government website images/maps or historical/assumed-author wide photographs. Complete current covered geometry comes from original elevation sampling/native extents; macro topography classification and buried geometry remain approximate.
